name: NASA GEDI L4A Footprint Level Aboveground Biomass Density
description: GEDI L4A Version 2.1 provides footprint-level aboveground biomass density (AGBD, in megagrams per hectare) estimates derived from the Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI) spaceborne lidar aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Operating since April 2019, GEDI's high-resolution multi-beam lasers sample 25-meter circular footprints across Earth's temperate and tropical forests (51.6°N to 51.6°S). Waveform metrics from return signals are coupled with parametric models to infer vegetation height, canopy vertical profile, and biomass density with quantified prediction intervals.
